'''Papyrus sedge''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can be used to make [[Paper industry|paper]] sheets at a [[farmer's workshop]] without the need to be milled into a slurry first.{{version|0.42.01}} Otherwise, it's useless &ndash; it's neither edible, millable, nor cookable.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] papyrus sedges for their ''useful stems''.
